questions.preview_text: Determine a parameterised cubic and scaled roots.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Use two polynomial factors to determine parameters and the remaining factor, then transform its roots under horizontal scaling.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Find a displacement, establish perpendicular sides from vector lengths/directions and combine two vector-defined triangle areas.

questions.preview_text: Fit and use a positive-integer binomial expansion.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Compare the first binomial coefficient to fit a constant, reuse it for the quadratic coefficient and choose a suitable small substitution for an approximation.

questions.preview_text: Fit and interpret a smoke-concentration exponential model.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Recover exponential constants from a logarithmic line through two points and interpret the one-unit-distance model value.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Express the given number as a power of the logarithm’s known argument.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Factor the logarithm’s argument using the two known arguments and apply logarithm laws.

questions.preview_text: Minimise a pool perimeter and assess an access constraint.
